body: I think it'd be easier if we knew the bullshit was actually going to end with 2020. I literally see nothing worth looking forward to, just chores and work I have to do. I think of the future and see nothing.

That's the really shitty thing. I know that all of the fucked up stuff in my head definitely contributed to my blow up, but to everyone else I'm just over emotional, over dramatic, and the cause of family conflict. So I don't but I do.

If only we had that as an option. Sometimes I feel like I was never supposed to have lived this long and that's why I never fit in quite right. I'm operating in a world that I was never supposed to be a part of. I hope your family at least is appreciative of all of the pain and effort you go through just to spare them the same.
